I figured I'd chime in, since my background is in veterinary medicine.

Not to defend these assholes and what they've done to their cat, but what the vet/technician did was very illegal (depending on provincial/state regulations, of course). Where I am, you have to get signed consent for euthanasia, and if the vet or technician takes it upon themselves to not go through with the euthanasia and then do something else with the animal (foster, adoption, etc.) they could end up losing their license.

What the vet should have done is have the animal signed over to him, and then treat the animal accordingly. This involves having the owner sign a consent form that they are relinquishing the animal to the veterinarian, and that the owner no longer has a say in the pet's treatment, medical decisions, or other care; essentially that the owner is no longer the owner. If the owner refused to sign the cat over, he could have contacted the SPCA for cruelty. The vet can also refuse to do euthanasia, although this opens up the possibility that the owner would just go to another vet clinic and have them euthanize the cat. But the vet could also give the owner an ultimatum: "either sign the animal over to me, or I will call the SPCA." Most owners choose option 1.

All that said, the way these fat fucks treated that poor cat is awful. Animals rely on us to keep them happy and healthy. They don't have self-control when it comes to food; if you fill their bowl, they will eat all of it. It's not their fault; they're animals. These fucking butter huffers don't deserve to own pets; they should have the rest of their pets taken away from them, and be banned from owning any more pets.
